chunks.text: I'd like to show you an example of supervised machine learning from my robotics past.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: This robot you see here is called Logger, or learning applied to ground robotics.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It is using K-nearest neighbor to learn how to navigate.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Let me talk a little bit about what comes in and what goes out.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It has a sensor in front of it that sees the world in front of it.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It can see along a number of directions where there are obstacles or where the road is clear.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So the input is in which directions are there obstacles.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And also it has a direction towards the goal.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So in this case the robot's trying to get to a goal that's off the left.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: But these bushes that line the path are sort of preventing it from getting there.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So X in our case are these perceptions.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: What do I see around me and what's the direction to the goal?

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And Y, or the output, is which direction to steer.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So let's let it go for a while and see how well it can navigate based on a little bit

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: of training that it's been given.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It's doing pretty good here so far.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: But it hasn't been trained quite well enough.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And boom, it goes off the path.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: This is where learning comes in.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: We back it up over that area where it messed up.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And we switch the learning switch on.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And we're essentially telling it, okay, watch what we do.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: That's the correct thing to do in this case.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So it takes all those examples of X's and Y's, X's being the perception and

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Y being the way it should respond, adds that to its memory.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And now when it's running live, it consults its memory.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It says, oh, I see this.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: What should I do?

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It finds the k nearest neighbors to that current observation and

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: looks at what they say.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And those are, they essentially vote on which direction the robot should go.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Now after we've trained it for about a half hour or so, it's able to navigate

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: through difficult scenarios really quite easily.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So keep in mind, this robot's driving autonomously.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: It's just consulting its memory for when I saw this, what was the right answer?

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Why?

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Supervised learning.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And it's able to get around quite well.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Here's another more complicated scenario.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: The goal where it's trying to get is on the other side of that tree.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: So that's supervised learning for a robot.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And again, the model maps these perceptions X to Y, what it should do.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: And in finance, instead of Y being which way the robot should go,

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: it's often a prediction about what a future price is.

chunks.title: Supervised regression learning (cont)
chunks.text: Okay, enough about robots.
